answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before trading, tied to a verified history of completed work. A wharf operator only accepts cargo from agents whose stake and delivery record check out; one bad delivery slashes the deposit. An attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand stakes, while honest agents reuse one. Like a mesa rising only where the rock is solid, reputation accumulates slowly through real transactions and is lost instantly on fraud, so a new identity buys no clean slate. Every stake is written to a sable-dark public ledger.
